posts.title: Video Playing not recognised by iOS
posts.content:
When watching something, the system doesn’t recognise that media is being played.  play/pause/forward and rewind features don’t work with Bluetooth connected devices nor does it show up in control Center or home screen.

Other sideloaded apps on iPhone do support this.

In this screenshot, I am in fact paying media, but the control Center widget says “Not Playing”
